constraints: Exactly one attempt for the recovered cell; no second chance at it.
No verdict, frozen record or artifact of run 40257143514 or any earlier run is replaced, repaired or reinterpreted; the recovered verdict is a companion published beside the run.
The source run's passAt1 stays null; this batch publishes no pass@1 of its own.
The official per-cell budget is preserved (fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1) and is not extended.
Only the one cell with no prediction is filled; no failed cell of the source run is re-run by this manifest.

knownRisks.imageDeliveredFromMirror: The attempt runs the identical image bytes from GHCR; if the alias plumbing ever failed the workflow's own probe stops the job before any model call, which would again be a pre-model failure and not a verdict.
knownRisks.noContaminationGate: Public egress and no gate: a cell that reaches its upstream solution is not detected here.
knownRisks.singleCellReading: One cell says nothing about the corpus; it only converts a verdict-less cell into a measured one.
